identity.description: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) by Meta, documented on Meta for Developers. Cloud API is the hosted Graph API interface for WhatsApp Business messaging.
identity.identity_notes: Fetched Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform docs and Cloud API overview. Assignment hint URL resolves to the right product. 'WhatsApp Business' is the consumer-facing app; the developer product is the WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API.

auth.oauth_flows: Facebook Login for Business sign-in is used by the official MCP server; the docs' main developer path uses system user tokens.
auth.token_refresh: User access tokens expire after 24 hours per search summary; system user tokens are long-lived (up to 60 days or can be made permanent per search summary). Temporary dashboard token expires quickly.
auth.scopes_notes: System user tokens need whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management, and business_management permissions.

access.production_restrictions: Test resources are auto-created and need no payment method to send template messages. Production use needs a Meta business portfolio; solution partners need App Review and Advanced access (per search summary, not verified on page). Business verification affects throughput. Production messages are billed per message; pricing pages exist but were not read in detail.

write_ops: send text, rich media and interactive messages
create or edit message templates (per MCP blog)
create, manage and message group conversations
api.rate_limits: 80 messages/second per business phone number by default; 200 requests/hour per app per Messaging account for certain endpoints by default.
api.limitations: Read operations and full resource list not verified on fetched pages. Official Python SDK not found; PyWa is third-party.
